data.name: Bipin
data.gender_notes: Bipin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bipin originates from Sanskrit and is derived from the words 'bipi' meaning 'conscious' and 'n' meaning 'in'. Thus, Bipin can be interpreted as 'the one who is conscious'. This name is often given to children who are believed to possess a deep understanding of the world and the ability to think and act wisely.
data.etymology: Bipin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Conscious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bipin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
